summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated bundled payload via downloaded Bun
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases at install time and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB script named `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a heavily obfuscated `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle using a rotating string-array cipher (a shift function and hex-only identifiers), and its name/content are unrelated to the package's advertised purpose of secure web fields for card data. The install script `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated with hex-named imports (`_0x488df8` from `fs`, `_0x52943e` from `https`) and string-lookup objects, hiding calls to `execFileSync`, `https`, and `fs`. Fetching a second language runtime at install time solely to execute a sibling opaque bundle — combined with cover-story obfuscation of both the loader and the payload — is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, chosen to evade Node-based static scanners. Any `npm install` of this package pulls in an alien runtime and runs an opaque payload with it on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
